title: Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構
summary: 以方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯解析Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture through square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。
scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構案例中比較Ankaa 接面與能階與方格耦合路由，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate ankaa junctions and levels and square-lattice routing within the Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture case.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Ankaa 接面與能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for ankaa junctions and levels.
steps.instruction: 在「Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Ankaa 接面與能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify ankaa junctions and levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
steps.check: 提交Ankaa 接面與能階的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for ankaa junctions and levels.

knowledge.title: 超導電路與非諧性
knowledge.text: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 本課架構對應：Ankaa 接面與能階
knowledge.textEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Course architecture correspondence: Ankaa junctions and levels

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 36 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0012 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^36=0.957695。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 36 independent events with equal p=0.0012: no-error probability (1−p)^36=0.957695. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構」的「超導電路與非諧性：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「量子實驗值班：證據有多準」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: architecture analysis” in “Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Quantum Experiment Shift: How Precise Is the Evidence” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就Ankaa 接面與能階的「超導電路與非諧性」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for superconducting circuits and anharmonicity in ankaa junctions and levels?
options: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。
所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels.
Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

quiz.explanationEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「超導電路與非諧性」模型，檢查Ankaa 接面與能階的兩個假想案例。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。

Distinguish "Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

steps.title: 耦合圖與路由：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Coupling graphs and routing: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對方格耦合路由提出可反駁的耦合圖與路由模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable coupling graphs and routing model and evidence record for square-lattice routing.
steps.instruction: 在「Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識方格耦合路由。原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。 建立耦合圖與路由的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify square-lattice routing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。
steps.observationEn: Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：物理位元數相同就代表相同電路成本。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal physical-qubit counts imply equal circuit costs.
steps.check: 提交方格耦合路由的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for square-lattice routing.
